name: Wireless Phones
page_description: In everyday business life, there is a need to move around in many work environments, such as hotels, hospitals or logistics companies. And even in industrial enterprises, many jobs are not exclusively tied to a desk but require a high degree of mobility with simultaneous availability. For these working environments, mobile phones based on DECT technology are the optimal solution, especially when they are equipped with optimum features such as multi-cells for up to 4,000 handsets and multiple charging stations for batteries and handsets. But even in small office environments, DECT is often an ideal means of guaranteeing mobility.
short_description: Mobile DECT telephony at the highest level

name: Audio Conference Devices
page_description: The technology of our (audio) conference phones benefits from 15 years of experience and development. Continuously improved voice quality and established software produce a high quality sound that also comes into its own when used hands-free with the cordless extension microphones and ensures an even distribution of “audibility” throughout the room. Today, the ability to conference remotely is becoming more and more important and is now indispensable for daily collaboration. This is especially true with regard to home offices and mobile working.

name: Location Gateway
page_description:
With Snom's location gateway solution, consisting of the Beacon Gateway (Snom M9B) and a tag in combination with the Snom M-series DECT base stations, people and objects can be reliably located, monitored, and protected.


Whether for determining the position of people (e.g., in the event of an alarm), locating devices (e.g., in warehouses), or as theft protection for valuable equipment, this solution offers a wide range of applications.


Similar to a satellite, the tag sends a signal to the Beacon Gateway (M9B) at regular intervals. The gateway forwards the information to selected end devices.


This enables, among other things:


Precise localization of devices and objects

Real-time monitoring of movements

Triggering of automatic actions such as alarms


Thanks to their high flexibility, beacons are used in numerous industries:


Logistics: for tracking goods and pallets

Museums and exhibitions: to protect exhibits

Healthcare: to locate medical devices (ultrasound, ECG, etc.)

Occupational safety: to locate lone workers

Beacons create an intelligent communication chain that optimizes processes, increases security, and gives you full control.


Good to know: Your existing DECT devices M70, M80, M85, and M90 also transmit beacon signals and can therefore be integrated into your overall beacon solution at any time!
page_subtitle: Localization, tracking, and alerting – smart and reliable
short_description: Locate people and objects anytime and anywhere

name: Special Application Device
page_description:
Announcements and Music on Hold

Everyone is familiar with announcements in hospitals, medical practices, public authorities, supermarkets, retail stores, and airports. The possibilities for broadcasting music, general announcements, or specific calls are diverse. For this purpose, Snom offers the optimal device with the Snom PA1+, suitable for any work environment.


The perfect solution for those who need to communicate without a telephone

The Snom SP800 is the ideal solution for companies that want to connect their employees via remote desktop or a cloud-based soft client without compromising on perfect audio quality.

When every second counts: Snom emergency telephones E303 & E303A

Visible, reliable, and immediately ready for use – the Snom E303 and Snom E303A set new standards for safety in buildings and public spaces. These phones provide a clear visual signal: easily recognizable as emergency phones from a distance and easy to locate even in poor lighting or for unfamiliar individuals. They fulfill the essential function of an emergency phone – to summon help immediately in critical situations.
